post.summary: Register a new company and create its initial subscription
post.description: For the Free plan, the company/subscription/user are created immediately and credentials are emailed. A given email can only ever use the Free plan once - even after the company is later deleted. For a Paid plan, NOTHING is created yet: a Stripe Checkout Session is created and its URL is returned in 'payment_url'. The Company/Subscription/User are only created by the Stripe webhook (POST /api/stripe/webhook) after the payment actually succeeds; if payment fails or is abandoned, no data is created.

phone.description: يجب أن يبدأ بـ 09 ويتكون من 10 أرقام

201.description: Free plan: company registered successfully, credentials emailed

202.description: Paid plan: redirect the user to 'payment_url' (Stripe Checkout). Nothing is created yet.

422.description: Validation failed (including duplicate email - companies.email is unique), or this email already used the Free plan before

get.summary: Get the current user's company attendance & leave policies (read-only)
get.description: Returns the attendance policy and the currently active leave types for the authenticated user's own company. Never accepts a company_id from the request. If no attendance policy has been configured yet, 'attendance_policy' is null; if there are no active leave types, 'leave_policies' is an empty array - both are still a 200 success response, never an error.

get.summary: Get the current user's company holidays (read-only)
get.description: Returns official/default holidays plus company weekly holidays for the authenticated user's own company. Never accepts a company_id from the request. If no holidays are configured yet, returns an empty array - still a 200 success response, never an error.

post.summary: Approve or reject a leave request (department manager step, then HR step)
post.description: role_context=manager: only the department manager of the employee's department, only while status=pending_department_manager. Approving forwards to pending_hr (after re-checking the leave balance); rejecting sets rejected_by_manager. role_context=hr: only an HR Manager, only while status=pending_hr. Approving sets status=approved (after checking for overlapping requests and the leave balance) and syncs the used balance; rejecting sets rejected_by_hr.

post.summary: Upload or update identity and/or university certificate documents
post.description: identity_image is required only the first time (when no identity document is saved yet); once one exists, both fields become independently optional so the employee can update just one file (e.g. add/replace only the certificate) without resending the other. Any field omitted keeps its previously saved file untouched. Creates or updates the employee_documents row. Does not change phone, residence, or other profile fields. Sets profile_completed to true once both profile_image and identity_image exist.

identity_image.description: Photo or scan (jpg/jpeg/png/pdf, max 4MB) of the national ID / identity document. Required only if no identity document has been saved yet.

university_certificate.description: University certificate photo or scan (jpg/jpeg/png/pdf, max 8MB), always optional.

get.summary: Verify Stripe Checkout Session after frontend redirect
get.description: Call this from /payment/success?session_id=... and poll until status=completed before showing success / login. Do not treat a Stripe redirect alone as success. Values: completed (account ready, email sent), processing (paid, still provisioning), not_completed (payment not finished).

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Stripe Checkout Session id from the success URL query (?session_id=) — same as transaction_reference from register/renew

post.summary: Stripe webhook endpoint (Checkout Session events)
post.description: Official Stripe webhook. On 'checkout.session.completed' with a successful payment, this endpoint provisions the Company/Subscription/User for a paid registration - this is the ONLY place where a paid company is created. Verified using the real Stripe-Signature header (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET), not a shared secret.

requestBody.description: Raw Stripe Event payload (sent by Stripe servers)
